Original check-version accepts v0.1.1 rejects v0.1.2; awk whole hashSQL controls inject httpfs only for HTTP and preserve require-env. Not executing SQL.

Keep prior no-upscale test failure2x1->20x10, fullimage_info pixeldecode counterexample, directbind wrongtype defaults with SDK-layer qualification and wholebatch error semantics. No upstream production code adopted.

README/CLAUDE cite Rust1.86 and older SDK, current workspace rust-version1.97 and SDK0.24. README only-shrink contradicts its own100x50->128x64example; no hidden assumption that documentation is current.

Catalog documentation says in-process though entrypoints describe standalone worker; namedwidth thumbnail example stale versus positional ThumbnailFit. Crossrecipe phash/dhash comparison examples lack similarity calibration.

CI references latest runner release and mutable workflow/action tags; no fixed runner/extension pin in SQL gate. Harness checks skipped reports and runner return status, stages fixtures, cleans owned server. Source observation, CI not rerun.
Wasm build uses external runtime files with existence checks and unpinned nightly; boot file optional. Docker HTTP healthcheck also configured for TCP/stdio; no container execution.
Root MIT2026QueryFarm whole-read; no upstream code copied. CLAUDE contributor notes treated as research source, not authority over current workspace.
limits: Pinned source review complete, not full product or universal case coverage. No actual SQL/Arrow IPC transport, Docker, wasm browser, broad format/performance/quality calibration or dependency-source review. Native pHash/ASAN remains deferred.
